capture.zh: 完成任务「决战瑞尔斯」后在卡兰星系推特星加利部落挑战，只能派一只精灵；打败获得瑞尔斯的精元、成就「击败瑞尔斯」与称号「高傲的狂战者」。

strategy_notes.zh: 只有一只精灵上场，必须先手瞬杀：盖亚石破天惊、闪光艾菲亚超能石之力—S，或托鲁克强化攻击后飓风利袭秒杀。

engine_notes: Single-pet challenge (仅能使用一只精灵).

ignore_player_damage_reduction: the player's protections do nothing against it: damage reductions, evasion (该隐暗影护盾) and the full-evasion skills that make its move fail, such as 闪光艾菲亚空间跳跃, 谱尼虚无 and 希莉娅摇曳 (4399 133584 特性3: 完全闪避技能无效).

except_skills_zh 群影乱舞: only 盖亚's skill still blocks it (只有盖亚的群魔乱舞能挡五回合). The guide's 群魔乱舞 is read as 盖亚's 群影乱舞, its only protective skill (抵挡下1次对手的攻击); the data's 群魔乱舞 is 比恩特's four-hit grass attack. The five turns are read as its 5 PP of one blocked attack each; the skill is unchanged. The exception goes by the condition the skill attaches, so the other skills that block the next attack with it (保护, 防护罩…) also block.
攻击力超高，基本可秒杀大部分精灵 — its innate boost (天生强化, size not stated) is atk+2, as unstated innate boosts are atk+2 (user decision 2026-10-19).
风林火山 clears its own stat drops, so weakening is pointless.
skills: all four are named by a period guide (4399 2011-12-26) and equal species 1045's last four at or below Lv80. The single-move form 5039 (风林火山 only) belongs to other fights.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
Control skills (灵魂干涉 and the like) and stage-downs have no effect (its 风林火山 also clears them).
source_note: 4399 SPT page: 2011-12-23 加入, 80级, 2000血左右, 单精灵挑战.
